title: Split free successive quotients
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K$ a bicomplex of $A$-modules with commuting horizontal and vertical differentials of bidegrees $(1,0)$ and $(0,1)$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let $T$ be its coproduct total cochain complex, with total differential $d_h+(-1)^p d_v$. Suppose every column $p>0$ is zero. For each $j\in\mathbf N$, fix a short complex $S_j=(U_j\xrightarrow{f_j}B_j\xrightarrow{g_j}V_j)$ of cochain complexes and an isomorphism $e_j:B_j\cong K^{-j,\bullet}$. For $n\in\mathbf N$ and $k\in\mathbf Z$, define the submodule $M_n^k$ of $T^k$ as the sum, over $j\in\mathbf N$, of the full image of $K^{-j,k+j}\to T^k$ if $2j+2\le n$, and the image of $U_j^{k+j}\xrightarrow{f_j}B_j^{k+j}\xrightarrow{e_j}K^{-j,k+j}\to T^k$ if $2j+1\le n$; omit a summand when its inequality fails. Equip $M_n$ with the restricted differential furnished by [lem-pc-derived-total-filtration-stable], and let $s_n:F_n\to F_{n+1}$ be the inclusion. Suppose every $S_j$ is short exact and split in every degree, and both $U_j$ and $V_j$ are coproducts of single-degree copies of $A$, indexed by sets in the universe of $A$. Then every $(s_n)^k$ has a left inverse and every categorical cokernel of $s_n$ is isomorphic to a coproduct of single-degree copies of $A$ in that universe.

proof.text: Apply the degreewise retraction theorem, which needs only the supplied degreewise splittings.

For stage n put j=n/2 and choose the two endpoint bases from h_free j. If n mod 2=0 use the first endpoint and the even cokernel theorem; if n mod 2=1 use the third endpoint and the odd cokernel theorem. In each case reindex the basis degree d by d-j. Pair the retraction and cokernel conclusions.

mathlib_searches.query: Successive quotients of the alternating column filtration are shifted endpoint complexes and the inclusions are split degreewise
An exhaustive split filtration of the total cochain complex of a nonpositive bicomplex whose columns have split short exact sequences

lean.statement: theorem quotients (h_exact : ∀ j, (S j).ShortExact) (h_split : ∀ j (k : ℤ), Nonempty ((S j).map (HomologicalComplex.eval (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) k)).Splitting) (h_free : ∀ j, ∃ (I₁ I₃ : Type u) (d₁ : I₁ → ℤ) (d₃ : I₃ → ℤ), Nonempty ((S j).X₁ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₁ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₁ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))) ∧ Nonempty ((S j).X₃ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₃ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₃ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A)))) : (∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ), ∃ r : (complex K S e h_positive (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (complex K S e h_positive n).X k, (step K S e h_positive n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((complex K S e h_positive n).X k)) ∧ (∀ n, ∃ (I : Type u) (degree : I → ℤ), Nonempty (cokernel (step K S e h_positive n) ≅ ∐ (fun i : I ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (degree i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))))
